summary_ja: NICT等が2026年に報告した、既設G.652-D fiber 39 kmでの450 Tb/s GMI・418 Tb/s復号伝送を追加しました。既設fiber活用の可能性と、多帯域部品、実時間DSP、電力、費用、運用実証の不足を分けて記録します。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds the NICT-led 2026 demonstration of 450 Tb/s GMI and 418 Tb/s decoded throughput over 39 km of deployed G.652-D fiber. It separates the opportunity to retain installed fiber from gaps in multi-band components, real-time DSP, power, cost, and operational evidence. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 既設標準ファイバの超広帯域化と導入境界
sections.title_en: Ultra-wideband expansion of deployed standard fiber and its adoption boundary
sections.summary_ja: NICT等による既設標準ファイバ39 km・450 Tb/sの研究実証を、実効復号速度、装置構成、商用化上の不足情報まで分けて評価します。
sections.summary_en: Assess the NICT-led 450 Tb/s demonstration over 39 km of deployed standard fiber, separating decoded throughput, equipment requirements, and commercialization gaps.

items.name_ja: 既設G.652-Dファイバ39 kmで450 Tb/s GMI・418 Tb/s復号
items.name_en: 450 Tb/s GMI and 418 Tb/s decoded over 39 km of deployed G.652-D fiber
items.timing_en: Presented at OFC 2026 and announced by NICT in June 2026
items.statement_ja: NICT、UCL等の共同研究は、ロンドンに敷設済みのITU-T G.652-D単一モードファイバ39 kmで、O/E/S/C/Lの5帯域、42.4 THz、1,273波長を用い、450 Tb/sのGMI推定速度と418 Tb/sの復号速度を報告しました。既設ファイバ自体を交換せず利用可能帯域を広げる方向を示す一方、送受信器、帯域別増幅器、合分波器、誤り訂正を含むシステム全体の実装が必要です。
items.statement_en: A NICT- and UCL-led collaboration reported 450 Tb/s GMI-estimated throughput and 418 Tb/s decoded throughput over 39 km of field-deployed ITU-T G.652-D single-mode fiber in London, using five O, E, S, C, and L bands spanning 42.4 THz and 1,273 wavelength channels. It shows a path to expand usable bandwidth without replacing the installed fiber itself, but requires a complete system of transceivers, band-specific amplifiers, multiplexers and demultiplexers, and forward error correction.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI拠点間回線では、敷設済みファイバを生かした段階的な容量増強候補になります。ただし、研究室の総容量記録を、利用者が得る単一フロー帯域、運用SLA、費用、消費電力と同一視できません。
items.hpci_relevance_en: For inter-site HPCI links, this is a candidate path for staged capacity expansion that retains deployed fiber. The laboratory aggregate-capacity record must not be equated with user-visible single-flow bandwidth, operational SLAs, cost, or power.
adoption_conditions_ja: GMI推定値とFEC後の実効復号速度を分け、payload効率も測定する。
O/E/S帯を含む増幅器、合分波器、transceiverの供給性、rack space、電力、保守手順を確認する。
既設fiberの損失・曲げ・splice・connector・分散特性を現地測定し、適用可能な経路を選別する。
adoption_conditions_en: Separate GMI-estimated and post-FEC decoded throughput and measure payload efficiency.
Verify supply, rack space, power, and service procedures for amplifiers, multiplexers, demultiplexers, and transceivers spanning O, E, and S as well as C and L bands.
Measure loss, bends, splices, connectors, and dispersion on installed routes and qualify applicable paths.

items.name_ja: 商用導入には多帯域部品・実時間DSP・運用評価が未確定
items.name_en: Commercial adoption still lacks multi-band components, real-time DSP, and operational evidence
items.timing_ja: 製品化時期は公表資料から特定できず
items.timing_en: Product timing is not established by the public sources
items.statement_ja: NICTの実験では帯域ごとの光増幅とオフラインcoherent受信を用い、論文はGMI推定値と復号値を区別しています。公開資料だけでは、全1,273波長を収容する実時間DSP、商用transceiver密度、装置単位の消費電力、障害時のband単位迂回、長期安定性、費用、標準化、量産時期を確認できません。したがって2032年までの製品ロードマップへ確定時期を置かず、研究候補として継続追跡します。
items.statement_en: The NICT experiment used band-specific optical amplification and offline coherent reception, and the paper distinguishes GMI-estimated from decoded throughput. The public sources do not establish real-time DSP capable of serving all 1,273 channels, commercial transceiver density, equipment-level power, band-level failover, long-term stability, cost, standardization, or volume-production timing. OpenFS therefore keeps it as a research candidate rather than assigning a definite product milestone through 2032.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 調達判断ではfiber capacityだけでなく、router port速度、transponder、増幅中継、監視、冗長経路、運用人員を含む端末間の費用・電力・可用性を比較する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Procurement must compare end-to-end cost, power, and availability across router ports, transponders, amplification, monitoring, redundant routes, and operations staff, not fiber capacity alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 実時間送受信、FEC、監視を含むfield trialで少なくとも数か月の安定性を示す。
現行C/L帯増強、fiber増設、space-division multiplexingとのTCO・電力・復旧時間を比較する。
標準、multi-vendor相互運用、spare部品、教育、障害切分けを調達要件へ含める。
adoption_conditions_en: Demonstrate multi-month stability in a field trial with real-time transmission, reception, FEC, and monitoring.
Compare TCO, power, and recovery time with conventional C and L expansion, added fibers, and space-division multiplexing.
Include standards, multivendor interoperability, spares, training, and fault isolation in procurement requirements.
